name: Cotton
source:
Cotton is a meek-natured sheep, who's most afraid of the cold. He never shears his wool more than necessary, which is why Banana Ranch is struggling financially.

Aside from the cold, he's also most afraid of the big bad wolf. After all, it's in a sheep's nature to be afraid of wolves!
